players.product: AOI inspection and AOR laser-repair systems (plus VRS and in-line automation) for FC-BGA and other semiconductor package substrates

quarterly_data.signal: Two correction filings (rcept 20261021900335 and 20261021900346) for two semiconductor substrate inspection and repair equipment supply contracts signed in 2025 with an undisclosed customer, now described as a Singapore semiconductor substrate maker (no relationship to the company): the counterparty changed because related work moves from the customer's Japanese entity to its Singapore entity as the Singapore operation is built up, and both contract end dates and disclosure-deferral deadlines were extended to 01-29-2027 to reflect customer acceptance and balance collection; 80% of each contract amount had been received by the correction date. Contract (1): KRW 15,375,583,022 (JPY 1,642,848,460), 16.82% of revenue (KRW 91,422,516,772), PO received 01-29-2025, previous end date 11-27-2026. Contract (2): KRW 11,399,024,157 (JPY 1,185,151,500), 12.47% of revenue, signed 02-28-2025, previous end date 10-27-2026. Terms: 30% advance, 50% interim on delivery to the customer, 20% balance on acceptance; details withheld at the customer's confidentiality request.
quarterly_data.figure: KRW 15,375,583,022 and KRW 11,399,024,157 contracts; end dates extended to 01-29-2027
